runs.note_on_the_single_fail: QA-QUDIT-033 is the preserved original QL-008 failure record. The same test, unmodified, passes after the wave-2 fix; that passing re-run is in run-log.regression-wave2.jsonl.

screenshots.review_note: Every unique image in the reviewed set was inspected: 74 post-fix at full resolution, 28 via 50% contact sheets with full-resolution follow-ups, 36 pre-fix images proven pixel-identical to an inspected post-fix image, and 42 differing pre-fix images triaged by pixel-diff change maps with 8 representatives read at full resolution. CAVEAT: a 50% contact-sheet tile is reliable for layout and colour, not for digits — one purity value was misread that way and corrected from a full-resolution crop. All numeric claims come from full-resolution reads or harness/oracle.py.

headline_scientific_result.question: Earlier QA recorded both 0.6150 and 0.8480 for apparently equivalent qutrit depolarizing experiments.
headline_scientific_result.verdict: 0.615000 is correct. 0.8480 was not reproducible by any configuration tested.
headline_scientific_result.repeats: 10/10 API repeats bit-identical; 5/5 independent UI sessions identical

release_recommendation: Ship as Beta. No P0 or P1 defect was found in either wave; all four quantitative pillars matched an independent numpy oracle to <=1e-9. Wave 2 found six further defects by looking at every screenshot, one of which (QL-009, malformed Dirac notation on a teaching surface) is an educational-correctness defect that 517 assertions did not catch. Conditions in report §K. Nothing here is self-approved.

waves.wave_2: 8 retest runs after inspecting every screenshot, 7 defects fixed (QL-008 re-graded P3->P2, plus QL-009..QL-014)

harness_defects_declared: H-1/H-2 (wave 1): two harness bugs and four wrong assertions, declared in report §I.
H-3: lib.mjs seedAuth() wrote ql.token/ql.auth instead of the zustand key ql-session. Dead code — every run authenticates through the real login form — so no result was affected. Corrected.
H-4: wave-2 script assumed an empty canvas; the lab ships with one f gate. Three runs tested the wrong circuit and failed loudly. Corrected by resetting the canvas.
H-5: wave-2 anti-vacuity probe recomputed atan2 from rounded components, hiding the very value under test. Corrected to read the API phase field.

H-6: wave-2 "banner in view" check used a loose regex that matched an ancestor and reported a framed banner when none was in frame. Caught by opening the screenshot. Re-anchored on div[role=status] with its exact text.
